end.parentNote: Yash practised building examples from cell to organism and discussed the digestive and circulatory systems. They correctly identified the heart and stomach as organs and later explained the sequence using muscle cell, muscle tissue, stomach, digestive system, and human. The mix-up about organs and organ systems was corrected by the end; at home, ask Yash to arrange the five levels in order and give one human and one plant example for each.
